meta.title: Sleeping in Contact Lenses: The Overnight Mistake That Can Cost Your Vision

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.vo: As an eye doctor, I see this mistake daily — sleeping in lenses. One night can scar your cornea.
beats.voText: As an eye doctor, I see this mistake daily — sleeping in lenses. One night can scar your cornea.

visual.desc: dark bedroom, phone glow off, person asleep with lens case still open on nightstand

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.vo: Your cornea gets its oxygen straight from the air. A lens blocks it.
beats.voText: Your cornea gets its oxygen straight from the air. A lens blocks it.
beats.caption: CORNEA STARVES OF OXYGEN

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.vo: Low oxygen, warm and wet — Pseudomonas explodes. By morning: a corneal ulcer. Scarring. Permanent.
beats.voText: Low oxygen, warm and wet — Pseudomonas explodes. By morning: a corneal ulcer. Scarring. Permanent.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.vo: Waking up with red, painful, watery eyes? Remove the lens and see a doctor the same day.
